name: Voris
description: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Grok are already answering with your brand. Voris tracks those citations, measures the awareness they build, and reports what they earn you in plain language. Cookieless, EU hosted, live.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voris to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voris to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.voris.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voris MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voris lists 16 MCP tools, including voris_agent_readiness_check, voris_ask_analyst, voris_detect_stack, voris_generate_consent_integration, voris_generate_event_call, voris_get_tracking_plan, voris_install_sdk, voris_lint_tracking, voris_propose_tracking_plan, voris_query_ai_citations, voris_query_ai_visibility, and voris_query_conversions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voris?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Voris in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Voris requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voris is developed by Voris. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
